messages:
Riley: Morning! finally installed a standing-desk converter + a cheap under-desk treadmill. very proud. pic: https://i.imgur.com/abcd1234.jpg :tada:
Sam: ooo love it. is the treadmill noisy? does it rattle the mic?
Riley: surprisingly quiet at 2 mph. only thing is my key clacks sound like tiny maracas on calls if i type while moving.
Lina: FWIW had a 20min outage yesterday. comcast status said "investigating" then magically resolved. pro tip: set macOS network service order so ethernet > wifi > vpn. cuts reconnect pain.
Omar: same outage here. dropped call during bug triage, used 5G hotspot for ~25m. cost me ~120MB total, not terrible.
Sam: anyone have a good, cheap laptop clamp/tripod recommendation? mine bounces when i rest my elbows.
Lina: i use a small monitor riser + a gooseneck phone holder clamped to shelf. velcro ties keep cables tidy. cheap and steady.
Riley: also thinking of starting a WFH gear-swap channel. who would join? react with :thumbsup: yes, :thumbsdown: no.
Omar: :thumbsup: i'd swap my spare monitor arm for a lamp.
Sam: :thumbsup: i'd join. desperate for better webcam angle.
ISPBot: Outage resolved for user subnet at 2024-08-05T15:22:40Z. Service restored.
Lina: thanks for the tips everyone. Riley, post the treadmill pic in #random-show-and-tell later so we can judge the cat photobomb rate.
Riley: will do. cat already tried the keyboard during setup so odds are high. :cat2:
